notes: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark recommendation numbers ('cis') are mapped only where a check clearly tests the same setting; unmapped checks have no CIS equivalent. Numbers follow v3.0.0 and should be confirmed against the edition you hold, as the benchmark is renumbered between releases. SCF control IDs and NIST CSF 2.0 subcategories are best-fit mappings; validate against the SCF release your client uses. Finding IDs are never reused or renumbered: retiredIds lists numbers that were reserved but never shipped. Google Workspace checks carry a "scuba" list: the CISA SCuBA baseline policy ids (GWS.<PRODUCT>.<n>.<n>vN) each check covers or relates to; checks without one are additions of our own.

controls.name: Instances use the default Compute Engine service account
remediation: Create a dedicated service account per workload and recreate or reconfigure the instance to use it (stop the instance to change its service account).

controls.name: Default service account with full access to all Cloud APIs
remediation: Use a dedicated service account with only the required IAM roles.
Where the default account must stay, replace the cloud-platform scope with only the scopes the workload needs.

controls.name: Instances accept project-wide SSH keys
remediation: Set metadata block-project-ssh-keys=TRUE on the instance, or switch to OS Login (CMP-004).

controls.name: OS Login not enabled
remediation: Set project metadata enable-oslogin=TRUE (Compute Engine > Metadata) and remove instance-level overrides set to FALSE.
Enforce compute.requireOsLogin (ORG-003).

controls.name: Serial port access enabled
remediation: Remove or set to FALSE the serial-port-enable metadata on the project and instances.
Enforce compute.disableSerialPortAccess (ORG-008).

controls.name: IP forwarding enabled on instances
remediation: IP forwarding can only be changed at creation: recreate the instance with it off unless it is a router or appliance.

controls.name: Shielded VM vTPM or integrity monitoring off
remediation: Stop the instance, Edit > Shielded VM: turn on vTPM and Integrity monitoring (and Secure Boot where the image supports it).

controls.name: Instances have external IP addresses
remediation: Remove the external IP (Edit > Network interfaces > External IPv4: None) and use Cloud NAT, IAP or a load balancer for access.
Enforce compute.vmExternalIpAccess (ORG-004).

controls.name: 2-step verification is not enforced
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > 2-step verification: allow users to turn on 2SV, set Enforcement to "On" with a start date in the past.
Apply it to the top-level organisational unit so every OU inherits it.

controls.name: Second factor is not phishing-resistant (passkeys / security keys only)
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > 2-step verification > Methods: select "Only security key" (passkeys and security keys).
Enrol every user with a key or passkey first, and keep a documented break-glass process.

controls.name: New users have no, or too long, an enrolment window for 2-step verification
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > 2-step verification > New user enrollment period: set it to 1 week or less (not "None").

controls.name: Users can trust a device to skip 2-step verification
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > 2-step verification > Frequency: turn off "Allow user to trust the device".

controls.name: Active users are not enrolled in 2-step verification
remediation: Admin console > Reporting > User reports > Security, or Directory > Users filtered by 2-step verification, to list them.
Contact each user, then enforce 2SV (GID-001) so the remainder are forced to enrol.

controls.name: Web sessions last longer than 12 hours
remediation: Admin console > Security > Access and data control > Google session control: set Web session duration to 12 hours or less.

controls.name: Password strength is not enforced as Strong
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > Password management: tick "Enforce strong password".

controls.name: Minimum password length is below 12
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > Password management: set Minimum length to at least 12.

controls.name: Minimum password length is below 16 (recommended)
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > Password management: set Minimum length to 16 or more.

controls.name: Password requirements are not enforced at the next sign-in
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > Password management: tick "Enforce password policy at next sign-in".

controls.name: Users can reuse passwords
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > Password management: untick "Allow password reuse".

controls.name: Passwords expire on a schedule
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > Password management: set Password reset to "Never expires" (rely on 2SV and breach monitoring instead).

controls.name: Too few or too many super admin accounts
remediation: Admin console > Account > Admin roles > Super Admin: review who holds it.
Keep between two and eight named, individual super admin accounts; remove or downgrade the rest to delegated roles.

controls.name: Super admins sign in through an external identity provider
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > SSO with third party IdP: assign "SSO off" (sign in with Google) to the OU that holds the super admin accounts.
Keep super admins in a dedicated OU so that is easy to scope.

controls.name: Administrator accounts are not enrolled in 2-step verification
remediation: Admin console > Directory > Users, filter on administrator accounts, and enrol each in 2SV with a security key.
Enforce 2SV for the admin OU immediately rather than waiting for the organisation-wide date.

controls.name: Accounts that have not signed in for a long time are still active
remediation: Admin console > Reporting > User reports > Accounts, or Directory > Users sorted by last sign-in.
Suspend, then archive or delete, accounts that are no longer needed.

controls.name: Conflicting unmanaged accounts are preserved, not replaced
remediation: Admin console > Account > Account settings > Conflicting accounts: choose "Replace the conflicting account" and communicate it to users.

controls.name: Super admins can recover their own accounts by self-service
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > Account recovery: turn off self-service recovery for super admins.

controls.name: Users can recover their own accounts by self-service
remediation: Admin console > Security > Authentication > Account recovery: turn off "Allow users to recover their own account".

controls.name: Third-party app access to Google services is not restricted
remediation: Admin console > Security > Access and data control > API controls > Manage Google services: set every listed service to Restricted.

controls.name: Only high-risk scopes are restricted for Drive, Gmail, Classroom or Chat
remediation: Admin console > Security > API controls > Manage Google services: restrict All scopes (not only "High-risk") for Drive, Gmail, Classroom and Chat.

controls.name: Internal apps are trusted automatically
remediation: Admin console > Security > API controls > Settings: turn off "Trust internal, domain-owned apps".

controls.name: Users can access unreviewed third-party apps
remediation: Admin console > Security > API controls > Settings > Unconfigured third-party apps: choose "Don't allow users to access any third-party apps".

controls.name: Less secure app access is allowed
remediation: Admin console > Security > Less secure apps: choose "Disable access to less secure apps (Recommended)".

controls.name: Marketplace apps are not restricted to an approved list
remediation: Admin console > Apps > Google Workspace Marketplace apps > Settings: allow only allowlisted apps (or none), and untick "Allow users to install all internal apps".

controls.name: Google Takeout is enabled for users
remediation: Admin console > Account > Google Takeout (or Apps > Additional Google services > Google Takeout): turn the service off for users.

controls.name: Some system-defined alert rules are switched off
remediation: Admin console > Security > Alert center > Alert rules (system defined): turn each alert On and make sure someone receives its notifications.

controls.name: Data at rest region is not pinned
remediation: Admin console > Account > Account settings > Legal and compliance > Data regions: choose a region for your organisation (needs an eligible edition).

controls.name: Data is not processed only in its storage region
remediation: Admin console > Account > Account settings > Legal and compliance > Data regions: tick "Limit data processing to the storage region" where available.

controls.name: Multi-party approval is not enabled for sensitive admin changes
remediation: Admin console > Security > Multi-party approval: turn it on for sensitive settings such as disabling 2-step verification.

controls.name: No active data-loss-prevention rules
remediation: Admin console > Security > Access and data control > Data protection > Manage rules: create rules for sensitive data (card numbers, national IDs) and set them Active.

controls.name: Owner or Editor role granted to users, groups or domains
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > IAM; find principals with Owner or Editor.
Replace each with predefined roles that match the job (for example Compute Viewer, Storage Object Admin) or a custom role.
Keep Owner for a small number of named administrators and review it with IAM Recommender (gcloud recommender recommendations list --recommender=google.iam.policy.Recommender).

controls.name: Service accounts with administrative privileges
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > IAM; find service accounts holding Owner, Editor or an *admin role.
Replace them with the narrowest predefined or custom role the workload needs.
Use IAM Recommender to see which permissions the account actually used.

controls.name: Project IAM policy grants roles to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > IAM; remove the allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers bindings.
If public access is intended, grant it on the individual resource instead of the project and document the exception.
Enforce the iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains organisation policy (ORG-005) so public grants cannot return.

controls.name: User-managed service account keys exist
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Service Accounts > Keys; list the user-managed keys.
Move workloads to attached service accounts, Workload Identity Federation or short-lived impersonation, then delete the keys.
Enforce the iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation organisation policy (ORG-001).

controls.name: User-managed service account keys not rotated within 90 days
remediation: Create a replacement key, deploy it, then delete the old key; repeat at least every 90 days.
Better: remove the need for keys (see IAM-004).
Use Cloud Asset Inventory or a scheduled job to alert on keys approaching 90 days.

controls.name: Users hold Service Account User or Token Creator at project level
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > IAM; find roles/iam.serviceAccountUser and roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator.
Grant the role on the specific service account (Service Accounts > Permissions) rather than on the project.

controls.name: Access granted to non-corporate accounts
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > IAM; review principals outside your corporate domains.
Replace personal accounts with managed identities (Cloud Identity / Google Workspace) or groups.
Enforce the iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains organisation policy (ORG-005).

controls.name: Default service accounts hold Editor or Owner
remediation: Create dedicated service accounts per workload with only the roles they need.
Remove Editor from the default Compute Engine and App Engine service accounts once nothing depends on it.
Enforce iam.automaticIamGrantsForDefaultServiceAccounts (ORG-009) so new projects do not grant it.

controls.name: Separation of duties: one principal is Service Account Admin and Service Account User
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > IAM; find principals with both roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin and roles/iam.serviceAccountUser.
Split the roles between different principals or groups.

controls.name: API keys without restrictions
remediation: Console > APIs & Services > Credentials; open each key and set an application restriction and an API restriction.
Delete keys that are not needed; prefer OAuth or service account credentials where possible.

controls.name: API keys older than 90 days
remediation: Console > APIs & Services > Credentials; create a replacement key, update the application, delete the old key.
Repeat at least every 90 days or remove the need for the key.

controls.name: Cloud KMS keys are publicly accessible
remediation: Console > Security > Key Management > key > Permissions; remove allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers.

controls.name: Cloud KMS keys not rotated within 90 days
remediation: Console > Security > Key Management > key > Edit rotation period: set 90 days or less.

controls.name: Cloud Audit Logs not fully enabled
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Audit Logs; enable Admin Read, Data Read and Data Write for All services and remove exempted principals.
Or set auditConfigs on the project IAM policy (gcloud projects get-iam-policy / set-iam-policy), ideally at organisation level.
Data access logs cost money; use log buckets and exclusions deliberately rather than leaving them off.

controls.name: No log sink exports all log entries
remediation: Console > Logging > Log Router > Create sink with no inclusion filter, to Cloud Storage, BigQuery or Pub/Sub.
Prefer an aggregated sink on the organisation or a folder (--include-children) so new projects are covered.

controls.name: Log export bucket without a locked retention policy
remediation: Console > Cloud Storage > bucket > Protection > Retention policy; set a period that matches your policy.
Lock the policy (cannot be reduced or removed afterwards, so confirm the period first).

controls.name: Default network exists
remediation: Create purpose-built VPC networks and subnets, move workloads over, then delete the default network.
Enforce compute.skipDefaultNetworkCreation (ORG-007) for new projects.

controls.name: Legacy network exists
remediation: Migrate workloads to a VPC network with subnets, then delete the legacy network.

controls.name: SSH (22) allowed from the internet
remediation: Console > VPC network > Firewall; edit or delete rules that allow tcp:22 from 0.0.0.0/0.
Use Identity-Aware Proxy TCP forwarding (source 35.235.240.0/20) or OS Login with a bastion instead.

controls.name: RDP (3389) allowed from the internet
remediation: Console > VPC network > Firewall; edit or delete rules that allow tcp:3389 from 0.0.0.0/0.
Use Identity-Aware Proxy TCP forwarding or a VPN instead.

controls.name: All protocols or ports allowed from the internet
remediation: Console > VPC network > Firewall; replace allow-all ingress rules from 0.0.0.0/0 with rules for the specific ports and sources needed.

controls.name: VPC Flow Logs disabled on subnets
remediation: Console > VPC network > subnet > Edit > Flow logs: On. Tune the sampling rate and metadata to control cost.

controls.name: DNSSEC disabled on public DNS zones
remediation: Console > Cloud DNS > zone > DNSSEC: On, then add the DS record at the registrar.

controls.name: DNSSEC uses RSASHA1 signing
remediation: Change the zone's key signing and zone signing algorithms to RSASHA256 or ECDSAP256SHA256 and update the DS record.

controls.name: Service account key creation is not blocked (iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation)
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Organization Policies > Disable service account key creation: Enforce (organisation, folder or project).

controls.name: Public access prevention not enforced (storage.publicAccessPrevention)
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Organization Policies > Enforce public access prevention: Enforce.

controls.name: OS Login not required (compute.requireOsLogin)
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Organization Policies > Require OS Login: Enforce.

controls.name: External IPs on VMs not denied (compute.vmExternalIpAccess)
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Organization Policies > Define allowed external IPs for VM instances: Deny all (allow named exceptions).

controls.name: Domain restricted sharing not set (iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains)
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Organization Policies > Domain restricted sharing: Allow only your Cloud Identity / Workspace customer IDs.

controls.name: Public Cloud SQL IPs not restricted (sql.restrictPublicIp)
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Organization Policies > Restrict public IP access on Cloud SQL instances: Enforce.

controls.name: Default network is still created for new projects (compute.skipDefaultNetworkCreation)
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Organization Policies > Skip default network creation: Enforce.

controls.name: Serial port access not disabled (compute.disableSerialPortAccess)
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Organization Policies > Disable VM serial port access: Enforce.

controls.name: Default service accounts get Editor automatically (iam.automaticIamGrantsForDefaultServiceAccounts)
remediation: Console > IAM & Admin > Organization Policies > Disable automatic IAM grants for default service accounts: Enforce.

controls.name: Cloud SQL instances have public IP addresses
remediation: Console > SQL > instance > Connections: use Private IP and remove the public IP.
Enforce sql.restrictPublicIp (ORG-006).

controls.name: Cloud SQL authorized networks include 0.0.0.0/0
remediation: Console > SQL > instance > Connections > Authorized networks; remove 0.0.0.0/0 and list only the addresses that need access (or use the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy).

controls.name: Cloud SQL instances accept unencrypted connections
remediation: Console > SQL > instance > Connections > Security: require SSL / encrypted connections only.

controls.name: Cloud SQL automated backups disabled
remediation: Console > SQL > instance > Backups: enable automated backups and point-in-time recovery, and test a restore.

controls.name: Buckets are publicly accessible
remediation: Console > Cloud Storage > bucket > Permissions; remove allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers.
Turn on public access prevention for the bucket and enforce storage.publicAccessPrevention (ORG-002).

controls.name: Uniform bucket-level access disabled
remediation: Console > Cloud Storage > bucket > Permissions > Access control: Uniform. Check that nothing relies on object ACLs first.
